from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOperatingCost(BaseModel):
    """A company's operating cost reported in one financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    operating_cost: float | None = Field(description="The operating cost amount as reported in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this cost, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the operating cost value from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_operating_costs: list[CompanyOperatingCost]
